?

Consider the finite region D in the xy-plane enclosed between the curves y=ln⁡x and x=e above the x-axis. What is ∬Df(x,y)dA expressed as a repeated integral?

a
∫01∫eyef(x,y) dxdy
b
∫01∫eye−1f(x,y) dxdy
c
∫01∫eye+1f(x,y) dxdy
d

e
∫01∫ey+1ef(x,y) dxdy
